hit_points.formula_note: At Acolyte levels, gain 6 HP + Constitution modifier per level.

design_identity.combat_style: Bless allies, punish the profane, create safe zones, and manage sacred charges through consecration
weaknesses: Weaker when forced into pure damage races

sacred_doctrine.description: The Acolyte chooses a guiding doctrine that changes the emphasis of their holy arts.

consecration.description: Through Aqua Benedicta, the Acolyte creates Holy Water Charges that can empower restoration, judgement, or blessing effects.

level_6.transition_note: Nivel ideal para comenzar la especialización hacia el Second Job.

skills.name: Sacred Doctrine
skills.duration: Until switched off, replaced by another doctrine, or combat ends
skills.description: El Acolyte adopta una doctrina sagrada que define si sus artes priorizan protección divina o castigo contra lo impuro.

base_effects.healing_done_bonus: Add your wisdom modifier to any healing you do

effects.healing_done_bonus: Add your wisdom modifier to any healing you do

Demon Bane.identity: Exorcism, radiant punishment and anti-profane pressure

base_effects.radiant_damage_bonus: Add your wisdom modifier to any radiant damage you deal

effects.radiant_damage_bonus: Add your wisdom modifier to any radiant damage you deal

synergies: Defines whether the Acolyte leans toward support or sacred offense
Interacts strongly with Restoration and Judgement
design_notes: This replaces Divine Protection and Demon Bane as passive skills.
Should feel like a meaningful combat stance choice.

skills.name: Restoration
skills.description: El Acolyte canaliza gracia restauradora para sanar o purificar, adaptando el milagro según la necesidad del momento.

overload_effect.extra_rider: Consumes 1 Holy Water Charge to also grant 1d4 temporary hit points

overload_effect.remove_conditions: Cleanse all removable negative conditions on target

intensified.effect: Use the intensified form of the chosen Restoration mode.

overload.effect: Use the overload form of the chosen Restoration mode.

design_notes: This replaces Heal and Cure as separate base buttons.
The Acolyte should always feel like it can choose between mending and cleansing.

skills.name: Sanctuary Rite
skills.description: El Acolyte consagra el espacio cercano para revelar amenazas ocultas o crear un refugio momentáneo contra el castigo a distancia.

overload_effect.extra_rider: Enemies revealed by this rite take 1d4 radiant damage

Pneuma.identity: Protective sacred zone against ranged pressure

base_effect.effect: Create a 3m radius zone that nullifies or heavily reduces ranged weapon damage entering it

intensified_effect.effect: Zone also grants +1 AC against ranged spell attacks

overload_effect.effect: Zone nullifies ranged weapon damage and reduces incoming ranged spell damage by 50%

base.effect: Use the base form of Ruwach or Pneuma.

intensified.effect: Use the intensified form of the chosen rite.

overload.effect: Use the overload form of the chosen rite.

skills.name: Benediction
requires: Ally or enemy within 9m depending on chosen blessing
skills.description: El Acolyte pronuncia una bendición o una negación sagrada que acelera, fortalece o debilita el flujo del combate.

overload_effect.effect: +2 attack rolls, +2 saving throws, +1d4 radiant damage on first successful hit each turn

Decrease Agility.effect: -3m movement and disadvantage on opportunity attacks

overload_effect.Decrease Agility: -6m movement, -1 AC, target cannot take reactions

overload_effect.effect: Reduce incoming physical damage by 2 and grant 1d6 temporary hit points

base.effect: Use the base version of the chosen blessing.

intensified.effect: Use the intensified version of the chosen blessing.

overload.effect: Use the overload version of the chosen blessing.

design_notes: This replaces Blessing, Increase Agility, Decrease Agility and Angelus as separate first-job buttons.

skills.name: Judgement
skills.description: El Acolyte invoca juicio santo para castigar a un enemigo con luz divina o para marcar a una presencia impura con condena sagrada.

overload_effect.extra_rider: Consumes 1 Holy Water Charge to blind the target for 1 turn on failed Constitution save

base_effect.on_failed_save: Target suffers -1 attack rolls and -1 saving throws for 2 turns

intensified_effect.on_failed_save: Target suffers -2 attack rolls and -1 saving throws for 2 turns

overload_effect.on_failed_save: Target suffers -2 attack rolls, -2 saving throws, and takes +1d4 radiant damage from holy sources for 2 turns
overload_effect.extra_rider: Against undead or demons, Signum Crucis has disadvantage penalty increased by 1

base.effect: Use the base version of the chosen judgement.

intensified.effect: Use the intensified version of the chosen judgement.

overload.effect: Use the overload version of the chosen judgement.

skills.name: Aqua Benedicta
skills.description: El Acolyte consagra agua ordinaria y la transforma en una reserva de poder litúrgico que alimenta milagros más intensos.
synergies: Empowers Restoration, Benediction and Judgement overload states
Gives the Acolyte a distinct technical layer separate from raw MP
design_notes: This is the defining internal resource tool of the Acolyte.

skills.name: Pilgrim's Passage
requires: Self, ally, or valid destination depending on chosen mode
skills.description: El Acolyte invoca un tránsito sagrado: un paso breve para reposicionarse o una apertura litúrgica para guiar el viaje.

base_effect.effect: Teleport target up to 6m to a visible point

overload_effect.effect: Teleport self and one adjacent ally up to 9m

base_effect.effect: Create an out-of-combat portal or travel anchor as allowed by campaign rules

intensified_effect.effect: Extend portal duration or expand party utility

overload_effect.effect: Enable stronger ritual travel effect at GM/system discretion

base.effect: Use the base form of the chosen passage.

intensified.effect: Use the intensified form of the chosen passage.

overload.effect: Use the overload form of the chosen passage.

design_notes: Warp Portal can remain mostly ritual/out-of-combat until later testing.

core_design_rules: El Acolyte es un support táctico, protector y exorcista, no solo un sanador.
Sacred Doctrine reemplaza Divine Protection y Demon Bane como elección activa de identidad.
Restoration reemplaza Heal y Cure como skill modular de restauración y purificación.
Benediction reemplaza Blessing, Increase Agility, Decrease Agility y Angelus como familia de bendiciones.
Sanctuary Rite reemplaza Ruwach y Pneuma como sistema de santuario y revelación.
Judgement reemplaza Holy Light y Signum Crucis como skill ofensiva sagrada modular.
Aqua Benedicta es el sistema técnico diferencial del Acolyte y genera Holy Water Charges.
Pilgrim's Passage reemplaza Teleportation y Warp Portal como movilidad táctica y utilidad ritual.
El Second Job no debería reemplazar este kit, sino profundizar sus doctrinas, bendiciones y exorcismos.
